title: Artifact for "Architecture-Induced Reward Hacking in NWDAF-Integrated LLM Control Loops" (IEEE S&P 2027)
description: Research artifact for the IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2027 paper "Architecture-Induced Reward Hacking in NWDAF-Integrated LLM Control Loops". It contains the PALA implementation (LLM agent, NWDAF tools, collector and IsolatedCollector, HedgeTuned session budget), the Docker Open5GS/UERANSIM testbed, the Open5GS/srsRAN (ZeroMQ) radio-side testbed, all experiment scripts, the stored trial results, and verification scripts. ./run_artifact.sh recomputes the paper's main-evaluation statistics and every srsRAN number printed in the paper from the stored results; the README describes the live reproduction and its hardware requirements. CLAIMS.md maps each paper claim to its data and lists the known differences between the paper and the stored data.
